Base font size at 1080p. The actual display scales automatically with resolution and DPI.
Horizontal offset from the character center. Negative moves left, positive moves right; the actual display scales with resolution and DPI.
Vertical position relative to the character node. Negative moves up, positive moves down; the actual display scales with resolution and DPI.
Color used when unblocked damage would kill the player. Changes apply on the next damage number refresh.
Color used when block is not enough, but the damage is not lethal. Changes apply on the next damage number refresh.
Color used when current block can fully absorb incoming damage. Changes apply on the next damage number refresh.
